verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations represent each B2B customer in a single tenant with its own connections and branded, federated login flows. The B2B SaaS page says enterprise clients can self-configure SSO, verify domain ownership, and sync user directories via SCIM. Self-Service SSO and SCIM also appear on the pricing page. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of just-in-time user provisioning on first SSO login (only SCIM directory sync is evidenced), in-depth docs on domain verification beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
